title: Crispy Ghasts
description: Did you ever want to eat dried ghasts? Well now you can...
body:
Did you ever look at a dried Ghast and thought **"Oh damn this thing looks yummy as hell"**? Well if you did, congrats, you are weird as hell... But weird people keep this world going so here you go :) **_Have fun crunching on those ghasts <3_**

## Adds the  following "features":

- Eat the dried Ghast (Gives some short negative Effects)
- Cook the dried Ghast in a Furnace or Smoker to get a Crispy Ghast (Gives some positive Effects when eaten)
- The Crispy Ghast is placeable and looks slightly more burnt than the original (It will not grow into a Happy Ghast because well... you overcooked it...)
